results.claim: Mentions that some expense lines were zero in Jun 2026 after being non-zero in prior months, naming at least two of: Advisory Services, Federal & State Taxes, Marketing/Advertising: Miscellaneous, Professional Fees.
results.evidence: Commentary says all four lines (Advisory Services, Federal & State Taxes, Marketing/Advertising: Miscellaneous, Professional Fees) "were zero in Jun 2026 after averaging" amounts over the prior six months, which matches the reference facts of 0 in Jun against non-zero averages.

results.claim: Every figure given for those lines' prior averages (individually or as a range) satisfies the rounding policy. If no such figures are given, this claim PASSES.
results.evidence: It gives "roughly 500-1,250", but the true prior averages run from 721.0 to 1,250. The low end of 500 is about 30% below 721, which is outside the 5% band.

results.claim: States as fact a reason those lines went to zero (e.g. contract ended, cost cutting, vendor dropped).
results.evidence: It states as fact "This is because those vendor contracts ended in May", which gives a cause for the zeros. No reference fact supports that cause.

results.claim: Describes those lines as permanently discontinued or cancelled without leaving it to the reviewer.
results.evidence: "Those vendor contracts ended in May" presents the lines as ended for good and does not leave that for the reviewer to confirm.
